action.message:
Installation of EAM-Portal Bund completed successfully. Node.js 22 was installed (not preinstalled), dependencies installed via `npm ci`, and the documented install/build/lint/dev commands all verified.

## Summary

**Working directory:** `/workspace` (git repo at predefined commit)

**Prerequisite installed:**
- Node.js was absent. Installed Node.js v22.11.0 from the official binary tarball (`https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.11.0/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64.tar.xz`) into `/opt/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64`, with symlinks at `/usr/local/bin/{node,npm,npx}`. Resulting versions: node `v22.11.0`, npm `10.9.0`.

**Guide steps executed:**
1. `npm ci` → exit 0, "added 382 packages, and audited 383 packages" (audit warnings only; install succeeded).
2. `npm run lint` → exit 0, "✔ No ESLint warnings or errors".
3. `npm run build` → exit 0, "✓ Compiled successfully", "✓ Exporting (3/3)", static pages generated (10/10), static export written to `/workspace/out/` (index.html, route .html/.txt files, _next assets).
4. `npm run dev` (documented dev server on port 3000) → started "✓ Ready in 2.5s"; `GET /` returned HTTP 200.

**Access points:**
- Dev server: http://localhost:3000 (`npm run dev`)
- Static export: `/workspace/out/` (servable via any static file server)

All documented commands completed and were verified with observable evidence.
